the P2X receptors expressed in mouse bladder are P2X1, 2, 4, 7 and that the P2 receptor mediated responses in bladder are mediated solely by P2X1.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the P2X receptor subtype P2X1 is the predominant subtype expressed in mouse bladder smooth muscle and is responsible for the P2 receptor-mediated contractions of the bladder.

the P2X receptor subtype P2X1 is responsible for the P2 receptor-mediated contractile response of the bladder, and that the P2 receptor subtype P2Y1 is responsible for relaxation of the bladder.
